why_a_separate_file: Community floors. The sync removes the tier, quota, auth, admin, Stripe, alerts, watchlist, annotations, social and sweep sources and their tests; what is left is covered slightly less densely than the pro tree, so the pro floors (76/91/87/87) fail here. Same ratchet convention: ~1 point under the measured actual. Re-measure with .sync/sync.sh --stage-only and run the suite there -- CI's community-build job does exactly that on every pull request.
